svg.title: A preference-data pipeline: prompts, candidate answers (on-policy samples, other models, strong vs weak), labels (people or a judge with swapped positions), filters (ties, near-duplicates, length balance, truncation, decontamination), then pairs for DPO, with a loop back for iteration
